name: Intercom Fin
bestFor: The highest-resolution-rate AI support agent, billed only for tickets it actually resolves
description: Intercom's AI Agent (Fin) resolves customer tickets autonomously across chat, email, and voice, and can run on top of an existing helpdesk like Salesforce with no seat cost.

freeTier.limits: 14-day free trial, no credit card required; no persistent free plan

paidTier.notes: Essential $29/seat/month (currently discounted to $19 for new customers), Advanced $85/seat/month, Expert $132/seat/month (annual). Fin AI Agent is billed at $0.99 per outcome on any plan, or standalone with no seats (a minimum monthly commitment applies when used with another helpdesk).

name: Zendesk AI
bestFor: AI agents and copilot layered onto the incumbent enterprise helpdesk platform
description: Zendesk's built-in AI agents and Copilot handle routine tickets, triage, and draft agent replies, billed on top of Zendesk's established omnichannel support suite.

freeTier.limits: 14-day free trial of the Professional suite; no persistent free plan

paidTier.notes: Support Team $19/agent/month ($25 monthly), Suite Team $55 ($69), Suite Professional $115 ($149), all billed annually. Suite Enterprise + Copilot is custom. AI agents are included; each plan includes 5–10 automated resolutions per agent/month, then $2.00 each pay-as-you-go. Copilot is a $50/agent/month add-on on Professional and up.

name: Ada
bestFor: AI-native, no-code support automation for very high ticket volumes
description: A purpose-built AI customer service agent platform (no traditional helpdesk seats) designed for high-volume, multi-channel deflection, configured without code by support ops teams.

freeTier.limits: No self-serve free tier; demo-and-quote sales process

paidTier.notes: Ada does not publish self-serve pricing. It bills per conversation (~$0.35 each) or per AI resolution (reported at roughly $1–$3.50 each) depending on contract. Third-party procurement data (Vendr) reports contracts ranging from roughly $36K to $314K/year — a market-observed range, not an official price.

name: Freshdesk (Freddy AI)
bestFor: A cost-effective helpdesk with AI agent and copilot bundled in from the entry tier
description: Freshworks' helpdesk with Freddy AI Agent (ticket deflection) and optional Freddy AI Copilot (agent assist) bundled into every plan, including the lowest-cost tier.

freeTier.limits: 14-day trial of the Enterprise plan; no persistent free tier

paidTier.notes: Growth $19/agent/month, Pro $55/agent/month, Enterprise $89/agent/month (all annual). Each plan includes a one-time 500 Freddy AI Agent sessions per account; extra sessions are $49 per 100. Freddy AI Copilot is a $29/agent/month add-on on Pro and Enterprise.

name: Gorgias
bestFor: Ecommerce brands (especially on Shopify) that want AI support tied to order and customer data
description: A helpdesk built for ecommerce, with an AI Agent that resolves tickets using live order, shipping, and customer data, priced per ticket volume rather than per seat.

paidTier.notes: Starter $10/mo (50 tickets, monthly billing only); Basic $60/mo or $50 annual (300 tickets); Pro $360/mo or $300 annual (2,000 tickets); Advanced $900/mo or $750 annual (5,000 tickets); Enterprise custom. AI Agent is a usage-based add-on at $0.90 per automated interaction on annual contracts ($1.00 monthly) — not priced per seat.

name: Salesforce Agentforce
bestFor: Enterprises already on Salesforce that want AI agents wired directly into CRM data and workflows
description: Salesforce's AI agent platform for service (and sales) use cases, acting autonomously on live CRM records — cases, orders, knowledge — inside the Salesforce platform teams already run on.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; requires an underlying Salesforce org

paidTier.notes: Agentforce User License $5/user/month (requires Flex Credits); Agentforce Coworker license $50/user/month. Flat-fee add-ons are $125/user/month (Sales, Service, Field Service) or $150/user/month (Industries); Max Edition starts at $550/user/month. Usage-based: Flex Credits at $500 per 100,000 (20 credits per standard action), or $2 per conversation. Salesforce Foundations includes Agentforce Builder and Prompt Builder at no cost.

name: Sierra
bestFor: Branded, customer-facing AI agents for large consumer brands, paid for by outcome rather than by seat
description: A conversational AI platform for building and running customer-facing agents across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and voice, with tooling to author, test, and monitor agent behavior.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; enterprise sales process

paidTier.notes: Outcome-based pricing — customers pay for resolved conversations and results rather than seats. No prices or tiers are published; quotes come through sales.
